secrets.name: APP_KEY
secrets.description: Laravel application encryption key (sessions, cookies, encrypted values). Laravel accepts only a 16- or 32-byte key in the "base64:..." form produced by `php artisan key:generate --show`; the generated placeholder is a generic random string and is rejected, so the sandbox generates and reuses a valid development key instead (see docker-compose.base44.yml). Supply a real base64: key here to take precedence over it.
